name: 03458 · Peterborough, NH
findings: ZIP 03458 (Peterborough) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03458 (Peterborough) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03458 (Peterborough) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
